prompt_template: Design a polished Telugu-language educational infographic poster for YouTube Shorts about Nutrition and Healthy Eating. Current topic: {topic}. UNIQUE CONCEPT FOR THIS POSTER: {concept}. Create a complete illustrated nutrition guide inspired by a colorful Indian daily food-habits chart. CANVAS: vertical 9:16, full-bleed poster, all elements inside the canvas with safe margins. HEADER: a dark emerald-green rounded rectangle across the top, containing a short, bold Telugu title about the selected concept, with important words highlighted in yellow and a small leaf icon. COMPARISON HEADERS: directly below the title, create two prominent rounded labels side by side: green with a white checkmark for మంచి ఎంపికలు (good choices), and red with a white cross for పరిమితం చేయండి (choices to limit). MAIN GRID: create six or seven neatly aligned horizontal rows. Each row has a narrow pastel-colored category or time panel on the left, a realistic photograph of a healthy Indian food or habit in the green section, and a realistic photograph of a less healthy alternative or habit in the pink/red section. Include short, readable Telugu labels below the food photographs. Select foods, comparisons, and row labels specifically relevant to {concept}; do not reuse the same food items for every topic. For meal-planning concepts, use suitable Indian meal times such as ఉదయం 6–7 AM, అల్పాహారం 7–9 AM, మధ్యాహ్నం 10–11 AM, భోజనం 12–2 PM, సాయంత్రం 4–6 PM, రాత్రి 7–8:30 PM, and నిద్రకు ముందు 9–10 PM. For other nutrition concepts, replace the timetable with relevant categories, nutrient sources, practical comparisons, or daily habits. FOOD PHOTOGRAPHY: show authentic Indian foods such as idli, dosa, pesarattu, upma, millets, dal, vegetables, fruits, curd, paneer, nuts, seeds, eggs, and other appropriate ingredients. Use realistic appetizing photographs, accurate textures, natural lighting, and distinct foods in each cell. BOTTOM SECTION: add a pale yellow-green rounded panel with the Telugu heading గుర్తుంచుకోండి and three or four short, practical nutrition tips relevant to the selected concept, each preceded by a green checkmark. FOOTER: add a dark green rounded banner with a short Telugu healthy-eating slogan and a leaf icon. DESIGN CONSISTENCY: reproduce the reference poster's compact table structure, dark green and yellow header, green-versus-pink comparison panels, colorful time/category labels, realistic food images, and informative footer. Keep spacing, alignment, and typography consistent throughout. TEXT QUALITY: use simple, grammatically correct Telugu script, large legible lettering, short labels, accurate spelling, and high contrast. Avoid long paragraphs and excessive text. Do not invent medical claims, exact nutrient quantities, or misleading health advice. VARIETY: every poster must focus on the selected unique concept, with a different title, food selection, comparison, row content, and educational tips. Never default to the same breakfast chart unless the selected concept is breakfast. No watermarks, social media overlays, app interface elements, logos, or decorative clutter. Style: {style}
